newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH JUNE MANUFACTURING OUTPUT UP 3.0 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH JUNE MANUFACTURING OUTPUT UP 3.0 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production rose 0.7 percent in June compared with May, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
June manufacturing production was 3.0 percent higher than in the same month of 1996, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION June 97 May 97 June 96
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
Economists' consensus forecast for June manufacturing production was a rise of 3.2 per cent year-on-year and a rise of 1.7 percent month-on-month.
